description:
PDF-76 / GitHub #26 word boundaries that are pure GEOMETRY. One page, Helvetica 24pt, UNCOMPRESSED content stream, four hand-authored TJ arrays written with no internal whitespace so the bytes on disk prove the point: [(Hello)-400(World)]TJ and [(Left)-700(Right)]TJ carry no 0x20 at all and must still extract with a word boundary (the -400 offset is 9.6pt, ~2.7x MuPDF's ~0.15*fontsize space threshold; -700 is 16.8pt, kept under the ~-900 point at which MuPDF starts a new line instead). The CONTROLS use the SAME mechanism at a magnitude that must NOT break a word: [(W)-20(a)-12(v)-18(e)-10(f)-14(r)-12(o)-16(n)-14(t)]TJ (largest offset 0.48pt, ~7.5x BELOW the threshold) must extract as the contiguous token 'Wavefront', and [(Over)+15(lapping)]TJ uses a POSITIVE offset, which pulls left and can never be a word gap, so it must give 'Overlapping'. Without those controls the fixture would be satisfied by an extractor that inserted a space at every numeric offset. Expected page text: 'Hello World
Wavefront
Left Right
Overlapping
'. Generated by gen_word_boundary_corpus.py.
